title: TigerGRCi - Privacy-aware · AI-driven · Continuous GRC
subtitle: TigerGRCi is the privacy-aware, AI-driven platform for continuous multi-framework GRC - evidence, risk, and mappings under human control.

kids.label: 1. Product & value
kids.summary: TigerGRCi’s product value is continuous privacy-aware GRC that replaces spreadsheet crosswalks with defensible, multi-framework control of real risk and evidence.

kids.label: Six value pillars
kids.summary: TigerGRCi stands on six pillars which are privacy-aware, AI-driven, continuous GRC, multi-framework, SCF cross-control, and lean delivery.

kids.label: Privacy-aware
kids.summary: TigerGRCi is privacy-aware by design: tenant isolation, local-first dictate, and evidence handling that never silently bleeds across programmes.

kids.label: AI-driven
kids.summary: TigerGRCi uses AI to accelerate mapping and briefing under human approval - assistive, never an unsupervised source of compliance truth.

kids.label: Continuous GRC
kids.summary: TigerGRCi runs continuous GRC: live evidence, monitors, and programme state replace point-in-time spreadsheet campaigns.

kids.label: Multi-framework
kids.summary: TigerGRCi is multi-framework: one control fabric serves ISO, NIST, SOC2, and peer packs without duplicate spreadsheet crosswalks.

kids.label: Cross-control (SCF)
kids.summary: TigerGRCi centres SCF-style cross-control so one evidence set answers many frameworks without inventing parallel control universes.

kids.label: Lean & pragmatic
kids.summary: TigerGRCi stays lean: sovereign self-host paths, truthful score caps, and operator workflows that favour audit reality over GRC theatre.

kids.label: Business case
kids.summary: TigerGRCi’s business case is labour saved on crosswalks, faster audit readiness, fewer GRC tools, lower residual risk, and sovereign self-host TCO.

kids.label: Doctrine
kids.summary: TigerGRCi doctrine: Report Ready ≠ operating effectiveness ≠ auto-CAPA; scores stay truthful; mappings stay human-approved.

kids.label: Narrative views
kids.summary: TigerGRCi narrates value through a five-act briefing, prior-art contrast, and an ROI stream tied to real platform capabilities.

kids.label: 2. Enterprise hierarchy
kids.summary: TigerGRCi tenancy is Platform → Tenant → Company → Business Scope → Workspace - governance and execution never mix scores across programmes.

kids.label: 3. Stack & deployment
kids.summary: TigerGRCi runs sovereign: Next.js 15, Express 5, Postgres RLS, Redis/WebSocket, Keycloak - Compose or Kubernetes, optional local Ollama, REACH outbound.

kids.label: 4. Four GRC fabrics
kids.summary: TigerGRCi is four fabrics-Mapping, Evidence, Risk, Regulatory Intelligence - one operating model, not four disconnected products.

kids.label: 5. Policy AI & mapping
kids.summary: TigerGRCi maps policy to controls with Hybrid RAG and PMCR provenance-human approve-first, never auto-CAPA from a design score.

kids.label: 6. Continuous & evidence
kids.summary: TigerGRCi proves continuous posture with 119 automated checks, evidence TTL bands, and dual design-vs-operating-effectiveness gauges.

kids.label: 7. Risk & VAPT
kids.summary: TigerGRCi scores residual cyber risk (EURMP/CRCE) and folds live VAPT findings into the same control and assurance fabric.

kids.label: 8. Security & Trust
kids.summary: TigerGRCi enforces Zero-Trust tenancy (JWT floor, RLS, RBAC, OIDC) and publishes real posture through Trust Center - not trust-by-brochure.

kids.label: 9. Master workflows
kids.summary: TigerGRCi’s master spine is upload → Zero-Trust gate → analyze → map → human review → approve/attest-Report Ready never equals OE.

kids.label: 10. GUI & journeys
kids.summary: TigerGRCi’s AppShell is the GRC operating cockpit - dashboard to Trust Center - for CIO, CFO, auditor, and assurance journeys on one tenancy model.

kids.label: 11. Catalog & frameworks
kids.summary: TigerGRCi’s catalog is 3,324 controls on an SCF hub - SOC2, ISO, NIST, PCI, HIPAA, GDPR, CIS, COBIT, and BB packs in one crosswalk plane.

kids.label: Product vs tenant vs standards IP
12. Ops, eval & docs
kids.summary: TigerGRCi proves itself with CI evals, SHA-256 export receipts, and a documentation spine that can defend every major product claim.

kids.label: 13. Scoring architecture
kids.summary: TigerGRCi scoring separates design alignment from operating effectiveness - and caps every displayed score under a truthful, reproducible prove-this-score bar.
